name: Dijon Mustard
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated on SIBO diets as it contains no fermentable carbohydrates. Use sparingly if sensitive to sulfur compounds.
preparationTips: Check ingredient labels to avoid added garlic or onion powder
Store in refrigerator after opening to maintain quality
Mix with low-FODMAP herbs like chives for enhanced flavor
Use as a base for salad dressings with olive oil and vinegar
nutritionalHighlights: Source of antioxidants from mustard seeds
